page_title: ESP 1-0 RMA | Espanyol v Real Madrid 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
90+8' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+8' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in a cross from the corner, but Joan Garcia reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+3' That was close. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+1' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
89' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Lucas Vazquez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' 1 - 0 GOAL! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) runs onto a pass from Omar El Hilali after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
84' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
83' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Fernando Calero (Espanyol) replaces Javi Puado.
82' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Madrid in a dangerous position.
80' Here comes a substitution. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Dani Ceballos.
79' The attendance for today's match is 33669.
79' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
78' Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

78' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Joan Garcia with a fabulous save.
78' Now Real Madrid have a corner.
78' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Joan Garcia with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
76' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
76' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
75' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
73' It will be a substitution. Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Roberto Fernandez Jaen walks off.
73' It looked like the long-range shot by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
72' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
71' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
70' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) coming on for Jofre.
66' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Urko Gonzalez will be replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
65' The opposition can't get near Rodrygo (Real Madrid), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
65' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
61' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) will miss the next game.
61' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Carlos Romero (Espanyol), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
61' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) launches a cross from the corner, but Thibaut Courtois is alert to thwart the effort.
60' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to get a shot on target, as the well positioned defensive wall comfortably deals with his free kick.
56' Alex Kral (Espanyol) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
55' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.
53' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) causes Joan Garcia little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
51' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the right post.
51' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Joan Garcia stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.

50' Ambitious effort from Carlos Romero (Espanyol). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
45+1' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
39' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Joan Garcia stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
37' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Alex Kral (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
29' Javi Puado (Espanyol) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
28' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
28' Rough tackle by Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid will take a free kick.
26' The ratio of the ball possession is 30:70.
22' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
20' Goal disallowed! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) scores but Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Jofre (Espanyol) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Thibaut Courtois easily deals with the threat.
17' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and sends his close-range header well past the left post.
15' Antonio Rudiger is substituted due to injury. Carlo Ancelotti gives a chance to Raul Asencio (Real Madrid).
14' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Jofre (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
10' The linesman signals that Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
8' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Ruiz signals.
1' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
